output.title: Return Walk/Run Intro
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min brisk walking → 10 x (1 min gentle jog @ Zone 2 / 1 min brisk walk recovery) → Cool down 5 min easy walking. Overall: Welcome back to your running progression with an easy, low-impact 20-minute run/walk routine. Your headline metric is 1 minute of unbroken jogging, repeated 10 times with equal walking recoveries. Reason: Connective tissues adapt seven times slower than aerobic fitness, so we must ease the Achilles tendons and plantar fascia into loading after your hiatus. Benefit: Gradually re-conditions lower extremity elastic structures while keeping impact forces safely dispersed across structured walking buffers. Warning: Stop immediately if you feel sharp localized tendon pain; ensure your jog pace feels embarrassingly gentle and conversational rather than rushed.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water only. Hydrate casually before the workout; no exogenous carbohydrates, sports drinks, or intra-run fueling are necessary for this duration.

output.title: Rest & Gentle Mobility
output.description: Process: Full rest day with optional light passive stretching. Overall: A complete rest day to let yesterday's baseline mechanical stimulus absorb completely. Take time off your feet to ensure zero residual joint inflammation develops. Reason: Novice and returning runners require dedicated non-impact recovery windows to ensure collagen synthesis outpaces micro-damage. Benefit: Stimulates restorative protein synthesis in tendons and replenishes muscle glycogen without adding neuromuscular stress. Warning: Check for morning stiffness or Achilles tenderness upon rising; grade your recovery and take note of any residual aches.
output.fueling_tip: Maintain regular balanced daily nutrition and drink water consistently throughout the day. No specialized athletic supplements or intra-day fueling required.

output.title: Postural Strength & Tendon Armor
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min brisk walking and joint circles → Bodyweight Box Squats: 2x10, 60s rest → Step-ups: 2x8 each leg, 60s rest → Glute Bridges: 2x10, 60s rest → Standing Calf Raises: 2x12, 60s rest → Cool down 5 min gentle hamstring and hip flexor stretches. Overall: A simple, foundational bodyweight routine targeting hip stability, calf resiliency, and basic movement patterns. All movements are performed using bodyweight only without external loads or explosive jumping. Reason: Strengthens the stabilizing musculature around the knees and ankles before we increase weekly running exposure. Benefit: Builds localized neuromuscular coordination and enhances joint resilience against impact forces. Warning: Perform repetitions smoothly with strict control; discontinue any exercise immediately if you experience sharp knee, hip, or ankle pain.
output.fueling_tip: Drink water to stay adequately hydrated; no specialized intra-workout energy or carbohydrate supplements are needed.

output.title: Consolidation Walk/Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min brisk walking → 11 x (1 min gentle jog @ Zone 2 / 1 min brisk walk recovery) → Cool down 5 min easy walking. Overall: Replicating your unbroken jog metric of 1 minute while holding a controlled 1:1 ratio over 22 minutes of total movement. Focus strictly on fluid, quiet footfalls and nasal breathing during the jog phases. Reason: Providing a second aerobic dose separated by 48 hours to habituate the musculoskeletal system to rhythmic loading. Benefit: Strengthens baseline aerobic enzyme density and conditions bone and fascia to repetitive ground reaction forces. Warning: Keep your pace strictly conversational; if you cannot speak a full sentence comfortably, you are jogging too quickly.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water only. No carbohydrate gels or sports drinks are necessary for a 22-minute session.

output.title: Aerobic Walk/Run Foundation
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min brisk walking → 12 x (1 min gentle jog @ Zone 2 / 1 min brisk walk recovery) → Cool down 5 min easy walking. Overall: The longest session of your opening return week, consisting of 24 total minutes with 12 unbroken 1-minute jog intervals. Walk portions are mandatory, purposeful segments designed to shed fatigue and keep heart rate low. Reason: Anchors your first microcycle volume while strictly honoring the 1-minute unbroken jog starting point. Benefit: Stimulates mitochondrial development and capillary bed density while safeguarding connective tissue from cumulative fatigue. Warning: If your morning resting heart rate is elevated by 10-15 bpm or your legs feel heavy and dead, switch the entire session to a relaxed walk.
output.fueling_tip: Drink a glass of water before heading out. Keep hydration simple; zero exogenous carbs or electrolyte mixes required.
